purpose: Groups related content and actions into a visually distinct surface. Used to present a single subject — such as a product, article, or profile — with a header, content and actions. Square corners, a 1px border and elevation 1.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title (a level 3 heading on static cards)

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Header subtitle in the secondary text colour

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions row below the content. Not rendered on interactive cards, to avoid nested controls

props.name: variant
props.description: default is raised at elevation 1; interactive is clickable and lifts to elevation 2 on hover; flat sits on the sunken surface at elevation 0. Defaults to default

props.name: padding
props.description: 16px for sm and md, 24px for lg. Defaults to md

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the card interactive when provided — sets role='button' and tabIndex=0

props.name: href
props.description: Renders the card as a link when provided

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label for interactive cards without a visible heading

props.name: as
props.description: Polymorphic root element. Defaults to div

props.name: selected
props.description: Marks an interactive card as the current selection. Sets aria-pressed (button) or aria-current (link)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Prevents interaction on an interactive card and applies disabled styling. Sets aria-disabled

whenToUse: To group a single subject's content — image, title, description and actions — into one container
To display a list of similar items (product grid, article feed) with consistent visual treatment
As a container for a summary or preview with a link to a detail page
whenNotToUse: As a full-page layout container — use page-level spacing tokens directly
For modal or overlay content — use Modal instead
To nest another Card inside — do not nest cards
antiPatterns: Nesting a Card inside another Card
Using Card as an interactive element without setting role and keyboard handling
Hardcoding padding, a border-radius or a custom box-shadow — use the padding prop and the elevation tokens

anatomy: Optional header (title, subtitle), content, optional actions row; interactive cards never render actions
sizes: Padding `space-component-padding-md` (16px) for sm and md, `space-component-padding-lg` (24px) for lg; slot gap `space-component-gap-md`
motion: Elevation and border over `motion-duration-standard`; none under reduced motion

a11yNotes: Interactive cards (onClick or href) must be reachable by keyboard with Tab
Interactive cards must have a visible focus ring using color-interactive-focus-ring
Provide aria-label only when the card has no visible heading or the heading alone is ambiguous; it must contain the visible title, words in the same order (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name)
Do not place interactive elements inside a card that is itself interactive — this creates nested interactive regions
